title: Install Visual Studio Code on Windows

location.start: Begin at “Install VS Code on Windows” and select the Windows User Setup route.
location.stop: Stop when the Explorer pane shows the web-foundations folder; do not configure WSL, containers, Settings Sync, or unrelated extensions.
location.note:
Do: Download and run User Setup, launch VS Code, create Documents\web-foundations, and open that exact folder with File > Open Folder.

Finished when: VS Code launches and reopens Documents\web-foundations as a folder rather than as one loose file.

Access: Free download; no Microsoft account, sign-in, certificate, or payment is required. Installation permission on the Windows user account is required.

Next: Install and verify the approved localhost preview route.
